messages:
marie: Hi team — spotted two unexpected items on my 03/31 paystub: 'GARNISHMENT - CA FAMILY SUPPORT' $420 and 'HMRC PAYE RECLAIM' A3150. I returned from UK secondment on 2026-03-05. I never got a notice about a garnishment. I'll DM the stub.
hr_payroll: Thanks @marie. Please DM the paystub and your UK final docs (P45 or final payslip). Don't share SSN here. We'll triage with Payroll Ops. :locked:
marie: DM sent (paystub + P45).
payroll-bot: Payroll batch #202603 processed for 2026-03-31; notifications sent.
alex: FWIW, two likely causes: (a) HMRC reclaim posted after your UK termination and got applied retroactively, (b) a garnishment match in the US linked to an address/SSN match. Both can happen concurrently. Need docs to verify.
sara-hr: @marie did you ever have a different legal name or prior SSN we should be aware of? Any court paperwork in CA in the last 3 years?
marie: No name/SSN changes. No CA court cases. The CA notice lists a case number I don't recognize.
hr_payroll: Plan: 1) Payroll Ops will investigate garnishment source and served order 2) If erroneous, we reverse and reimburse on next payroll + cover bank fees 3) Coordinate with UK payroll about HMRC reclaim reversal 4) Update within 5 business days. Sound okay?
marie: Yes, thank you.
alex: @finance_ops please advise on refund mechanics and tax consequences. If garnishment is wrongly applied, the refund should include net amount + any fees/interest; for HMRC reclaim we may need a credit or reclaim through UK payroll.
finance_ops: Acknowledge. We'll track on finance side. If tax was withheld incorrectly we'll evaluate whether a gross-up or amended reporting is necessary.
marie: I uploaded a court denial PDF (not related) and my final UK payslip to the secure bucket.
hr_payroll: Received. Escalating to Payroll Ops + Legal. @payroll-bot create an investigation ticket.
payroll-bot: Ticket #PAY-2026-02 created: "Investigate possible erroneous CA garnishment + HMRC reclaim" (linked to thread 1783006001).
alex: Payroll Ops next steps: validate the garnishment order (court of origin, serving entity), confirm identity match, request withdrawal if wrong, prepare reversal entry for April payroll. Also contact UK payroll for reclaim/credit procedures for the A3150.
payroll-bot: Sensitive docs stored in People Ops secure bucket. Access limited to payroll/legal/people-ops.
sara-hr: Marie we'll send the first update EOD +5 business days. Really sorry for the extra worry.
marie: Appreciate the support :pray:
